# Cale AI Workbench 0.24.10 for Windows

Create Song now makes a square, full-length music video by default. It combines Cale Media cover art with a waveform driven by the song and a permanent bottom credit reading “Made by Cale AI Workbench”. The checkbox under Output options reads “Create a music video”. Turn it off to generate audio only.

Use **Share to socials** beside a finished recording. The app opens the selected site and selects the verified media in File Explorer for you to attach. Audio works with SoundCloud. Songs with video also offer YouTube, TikTok and Facebook. You choose when to publish.

The playlist now shows the active generation step in plain language, including “Writing lyrics”.

A plain dubstep request gives the renderer a numeric 140 BPM target, a half-time backbeat and varied bass phrases. Riddim, tearout, brostep, melodic dubstep and deep dubstep have distinct production directions. Explicit BPM and supported key and meter requests take precedence. A fresh “song about” prompt selects vocals. Generated drop-led hooks keep the subject and leave space for instrumental sections. Manual performance choices and user-written lyrics are preserved.

## Validation

The preceding release generated an instrumental from the Cale Media test prompt with a measured pulse near 120 BPM. A controlled comparison on the same 60-second prompt, lyrics and random seed retained the eight-step ODE sampler. ODE rendered in 5.81 seconds and passed the vocal check with 33 matched lyric terms. SDE took 6.21 seconds and matched 22 terms, with the last recognized match too early for acceptance. These measurements cover the renderer only.

All 21 adapter checks passed, including full-stream MP4 decoding and source audio binding. The native hook arrangement regression passed. The native music, worker and updater test groups passed 35 checks, with one separate opt-in WAV fixture case excluded.

Source commit 2371401f4bb6143d388e93b2cd684d8447bf0ce1.


## Desktop generation and sharing

On this PC the exact Cale Media request passed vocal verification on 1 of 5 automatic vocal takes at durations of 60, 120 seconds. Recognition of the company name, acronym and later hooks was inconsistent. Workbench retained each rejected take. The vocal example video has a measured pulse at 70.0 BPM and a renderer target of 140 BPM.

The installed-format desktop build displayed the concise video checkbox and the clean “Writing lyrics” status during generation. Its playlist exposed SoundCloud for the WAV and YouTube, TikTok and Facebook for MP4. The example passed full-stream decoding and checksum comparison. Frames at 2, 29 and 55 seconds show a changing waveform and a fixed bottom credit.
